newsitem.title: DUBAI: Gulf papers blame Netanyahu policy for Israel bomb.
newsitem.headline: Gulf papers blame Netanyahu policy for Israel bomb.

text.p: Gulf Arab newspapers on Saturday blamed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Middle East peace policies for Friday's deadly bombing in Tel Aviv.
They accused him of fomenting unrest and sabotaging the peace process by forging ahead with a controversial Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.

"It is the world's right to condemn Friday's blast in the Tel Aviv cafe," said the United Arab Emirates newspaper al-Khaleej. "But the world has to point the finger of accusation at Netanyahu and no one else...His racist and stupid policies are pushing the whole region into a circle of violence and bloodshed."
Kuwait's al-Rai al-Aam daily said: "Any level-headed person has to understand from Netanyahu's insolence that the building of the settlement was an act of aggression."

Qatar's Arabic-language al-Sharq said: "Netanyahu can only blame himself for the attack...It is better if he and his government look for the causes that led to it, instead of throwing blame and making threats."
Saudi Arabia's Ukaz newspaper said: "We tell Netanyahu that these dangerous policies he is pursuing will explode the region and take the world to a more dangerous situation."
